cards.art: eight-armed octopus on full drum kit, confused animal audience
cards.lore: Decide rate vs. rhythm control, and calculate stroke risk!
cards.name: Fibby Fitz (Atrial Fibrillation)
cards.power: Improvise – Ventricles only catch every 3rd beat.

cards.art: frantic hummingbird at velvet rope, turtle bouncer blocking half the crowd
cards.lore: Vagal maneuvers unmask the flutter waves.
cards.name: Flutterby (Atrial Flutter)
cards.power: 2:1 Velvet Rope – Ventricular rate locks at 150.

cards.art: leather-jacketed wolf slipping past closed BOUNCER door into dark club
cards.lore: Do NOT give digoxin or AV-blockers if Fibby Fitz is in the club!
cards.name: The Wolf (WPW Syndrome)
cards.power: Delta Wave Bypass – Skip AV node delay.

cards.art: massive serpent leveling city skyline in lightning storm, GAME OVER stamp
cards.lore: Shock first, ask questions later. No pulse, no negotiation.
cards.name: Vera Fib (Ventricular Fibrillation)
cards.power: Total Blackout – Eliminate pulse.

cards.art: top-hatted turtle with magnifying glass inspecting passes, long creature queue
cards.lore: Benign. No treatment needed.
cards.name: Mr. Block (1st Degree)
cards.power: The Long Wait – Delay, but never drop.

cards.art: wilting sloth guard with fraying power lines, tiny squirrel alarmed
cards.lore: Predictable pattern, rarely needs a pacemaker.
cards.name: Wenky (Mobitz I)
cards.power: Predictable Fatigue – Progressively lengthen PR, then drop QRS.

cards.art: leather kangaroo kicking wooden stairs out randomly, tiny mouse falling
cards.lore: Highly dangerous; often progresses to complete block. Pacemaker required.
cards.name: Moe Bitz (Mobitz II)
cards.power: Random Drop – Drop QRS without warning.

cards.art: gorilla general with P-flag birds and R-flag bears marching opposite directions
cards.lore: Bridge therapy required while waiting for the pacemaker!
cards.name: The General (3rd Degree)
cards.power: Severed Comms – Atria and Ventricles march to their own beat.

cards.art: cheetah in black jacket wielding ECG-traced knife blade
cards.lore: Check for pulse! Stable gets meds, unstable gets electricity.
cards.name: Tach the Knife (Ventricular Tachycardia)
cards.power: ORGANIZED SPEED – WIDE QRS COMPLEX TACHYCARDIA.

cards.art: masked falcon dropping large rock onto Formula 1 track, cars scattering
cards.lore: Used to unmask hidden rhythms and terminate SVT.
cards.name: Adenosine Assassin
cards.power: HARD RESET – BRIEFLY FLATLINE THE AV NODE.

cards.art: blue-ringed octopus gripping Na, K, Ca, Beta coral handles in reef
cards.lore: Watch for thyroid, lung, liver, and blue-gray skin toxicity!
cards.name: Ami the Amiodarone
cards.power: CHAOS AGENT – DELAY REPOLARIZATION GLOBALLY.

cards.art: two identical red-crested woodpeckers on branch, ECG squiggle between them
cards.lore: Rate control is often just as good as rhythm control in AFib.
cards.name: The Metronome Twins
cards.power: AFFIRM Trial – CHOOSE RATE OR RHYTHM.

cards.art: porcupine squeezing garden hose onto spinning exercise ball, droplets stopping at rest
cards.lore: Predictable and reproducible. Fixed stenosis.
cards.name: Stabby Angina
cards.power: Demand Ischemia – Attack only during exercise, retreat at rest.

cards.art: furious honey badger in cracked armchair firing bazooka at rest
cards.lore: Differentiate from NSTEMI by checking Troponin.
cards.name: Unstable Stan
cards.power: Plaque Rupture – Attack without provocation.

cards.art: shocked beaver plumber in flooded basement, red ST-wave geyser erupting from pipe
cards.lore: Complete occlusion. Time is muscle. Get to the cath lab!
cards.name: The Plumber (STEMI)
cards.power: Transmural Block – Elevate ST segments and kill muscle.

cards.art: bloodhound with magnifying glass tracking glowing leaking heart traces
cards.lore: Sensitive but not specific. Rises in demand ischemia, PE, and renal failure too.
cards.name: Troponin Tim
cards.power: Leakage Indicator – Detect microscopic cardiac injury.

cards.art: venomous snake coiled in glowing radioactive barrel, green poison glow
cards.lore: The most dangerous plaques are vulnerable, not the most occlusive.
cards.name: Lady Lipid
cards.power: Vulnerable Plaque – Infiltrate and wait for rupture.

cards.art: hard-hatted beaver wielding pickaxe on cholesterol and APO-B boulders
cards.lore: Watch the CK levels for myopathy/rhabdo! Give high-intensity post-MI.
cards.name: Statins the Sculptor
cards.power: HMG-CoA Block – Upregulate LDL receptors.

cards.art: massive ancient snapping turtle jaw-locked onto COX-1 gear cog chain
cards.lore: Only a fresh platelet transfusion partially reverses her effect.
cards.name: Aspirin the Ancient
cards.power: Irreversible Acetylation – Disable platelet thromboxane A2 forever.

cards.art: tick stuffed into ADP keyhole on platelet surface, golden key refused
cards.lore: Combines with Aspirin for DAPT after stent placement.
cards.name: Ticky the P2Y₁₂ Blocker
cards.power: ADP Blockade – Prevent platelet aggregation.

cards.art: chameleon on forked pipe releasing NO vapor cloud in two directions
cards.lore: Fatal hypotension if combined with PDE5 inhibitors! Avoid in RV infarcts.
cards.name: Nitro the Negotiator
cards.power: Venodilation – Relieve angina and pulmonary edema.

cards.art: grizzly bear arms spread blocking saloon doors, anatomical heart glowing inside
cards.lore: Contraindicated acutely in decompensated HF or severe block.
cards.name: Beta the Bouncer
cards.power: Cardioprotection – Reduce oxygen demand and block remodeling.

cards.art: yellow weaver bird perching inside stent mesh tunnel, woven coronary scaffold
cards.lore: Drug-eluting stents (DES) prevent restenosis but need longer DAPT.
cards.name: The Stent Architect
cards.power: Scaffold – Hold open the culprit lesion.

cards.art: hard-hatted mole drilling new tunnel around blocked pipe obstruction
cards.lore: Preferred for left main disease, 3-vessel disease, and complex diabetics.
cards.name: Bypass the Builder (CABG)
cards.power: New Plumbing – Bypass the obstruction entirely.

cards.art: drooping basset hound in fire helmet gripping leaking hose in flooded floor
cards.lore: Classify functional severity using the NYHA class.
cards.name: Franko the Failing Heart
cards.power: Weak Squeeze – Drop output, pool fluid.

cards.art: puffed-up blowfish hovering in flood-water apartment room, BNP label on wall
cards.lore: Differentiate cardiac from pulmonary dyspnea using BNP/NT-proBNP.
cards.name: Eddie Edema
cards.power: Back-pressure – Flood the alveoli (crackles, orthopnea).

cards.art: spider web across red arterial tunnel, Angiotensin II villains tangled
cards.lore: Causes a bradykinin-mediated dry cough. Switch to ARB if intolerable!
cards.name: ACE the Architect of Afterload
cards.power: Vasodilation – Drop afterload, stop remodeling.

cards.art: armored rhino boxer holding PARADIGM-HF championship belt in corner
cards.lore: Wait 36 hours after stopping ACEi before starting Arnie (Angioedema risk)!
cards.name: Arnie the ARNi
cards.power: Dual Strike – Block AT1 receptor AND boost natriuretic peptides.

cards.art: two-humped camel spitting potassium cubes, mountain of bananas piled behind
cards.lore: Reduces mortality in severe HFrEF, but watch for hyperkalemia and gynecomastia!
cards.name: Aldo the Antagonist
cards.power: Anti-Fibrotic – Block the mineralocorticoid receptor.

cards.art: sugar glider surfing swirling glucose wave in kidney tubule, sugar cubes flying
cards.lore: The diabetes drug that became a heart failure mortality-reducing hero!
cards.name: SGLT2 Stan
cards.power: Osmotic Diuresis – Block glucose reabsorption in the kidney.

cards.art: orange fox with green swirling spiral eyes holding foxglove flower
cards.lore: Hypokalemia dramatically increases the risk of Diggy toxicity!
cards.name: Diggy the Digoxin
cards.power: Inotropic Boost – Inhibit Na/K-ATPase to increase intracellular Calcium.

cards.art: brown pelican standing in Loop of Henle structure, massive flood pouring from beak
cards.lore: The front-line decongestive in acute HF. Watch for ototoxicity at high IV doses.
cards.name: Lou the Loop
cards.power: Flash Flood – Massive diuresis via ascending loop of Henle.

cards.art: bloated warty toad expanding in cardiac chamber, walls visibly thinning
cards.lore: ACEi, Beta-Blockers, and Aldo-antagonists starve this monster.
cards.name: The Remodeling Monster
cards.power: Dilate & Thin – Change ventricular geometry over time.

cards.art: electric manta ray fused into dark chest cavity, lightning coiling from leads
cards.lore: Primary prevention of sudden cardiac death in optimized HFrEF.
cards.name: ICD Ivan
cards.power: Silent Guardian – Deliver synchronized shock for VT, unsync for VF.

cards.art: firefly pulsing between two lanterns labeled L and R, light beams merging
cards.lore: Indicated specifically for HFrEF patients with LBBB morphology.
cards.name: Cardie the CRT
cards.power: Resynchronization – Force Left and Right ventricles to squeeze together.

cards.art: seagull soaring with golden HEART PASS passport in beak, ocean below
cards.lore: Contraindicated by active infection, malignancy, or severe fixed pulmonary HTN.
cards.name: Transplant Passport
cards.power: New Engine – Swap Franko out completely.

cards.art: frantic hare sprinting from DANGER-zone pressure gauge with exploding dial
cards.lore: Urgency = no organ damage (oral meds). Emergency = organ damage (IV meds).
cards.name: Hyper Hugo
cards.power: Silent Killer – Sustain high pressure indefinitely.

cards.art: two-headed snake coiled around anatomical kidney, angiotensin II spikes
cards.lore: Feeds on low renal perfusion and sympathetic activation. Block it at multiple levels!
cards.name: The RAAS Serpent
cards.power: Constrict & Retain – Spike BP and hoard volume.

cards.art: snail melting like slime onto calcium-labeled pipes, MELT DOWN speech bubble
cards.lore: Dihydropyridines (amlodipine) cause edema. Verapamil slows the AV node and causes constipation.
cards.name: Cal the Calcium Blocker
cards.power: Smooth Muscle Relax – Block L-type calcium channels.

cards.art: uniformed fox sheriff chasing NaCl crystals from Distal Convoluted Tubule sign
cards.lore: First-line agent! Causes hypokalemia, hyponatremia, and hyperuricemia (watch for gout).
cards.name: Thia the Thiazide
cards.power: Volume Drop – Block NaCl cotransport.

cards.art: rabid dark dog biting Alpha-1 receptor pipe fitting, pressure dropping
cards.lore: Great for BPH, but causes brutal first-dose orthostatic hypotension!
cards.name: Alpha Annie
cards.power: Arterial Drop – Sudden peripheral vasodilation.

cards.art: pregnant seahorse with defibrillator harness in turbulent lightning ocean
cards.lore: Mag sulfate is for seizures, NOT BP control. Give Labetalol or Nifedipine. Cure = Delivery.
cards.name: Eclampsia Emergency
cards.power: Systemic Storm – HTN + Proteinuria + End-organ failure.

cards.art: black panther injecting glowing NO syringe into branching artery at speed
cards.lore: Perfect for emergencies, but prolonged use risks Cyanide Toxicity! Monitor a-line.
cards.name: Nitro the Night Rider
cards.power: Instant Drop – Second-by-second BP control.

cards.art: rust-brown sweating octopus, metanephrine vapor clouds, headache lightning bolts
cards.lore: MUST give Alpha-blocker BEFORE Beta-blocker, or risk a lethal hypertensive crisis!
cards.name: Pheo the Hidden Villain
cards.power: Catecholamine Dump – Episodic HTN, headache, diaphoresis.

cards.art: mantis shrimp punch exploding pipe apart, fluid spraying, crack propagating downward
cards.lore: Type A (Ascending) = Surgical Emergency. Type B (Descending) = Medical management (HR/BP control).
cards.name: The Aorta Splitter
cards.power: Tearing Pain – Propagate the flap down the aorta.

cards.art: three raccoons hiding behind dumpster, each holding a cause symbol
cards.lore: Suspect if BP is refractory to 3 agents or starts before age 30!
cards.name: The Secondary Suspects
cards.power: Hidden Cause – Sleep apnea, Renal artery stenosis, Aldosteronism.

cards.art: armadillo body jammed in RESTRICTED ACCESS outflow door, red cells piling behind
cards.lore: Symptoms = Angina, Syncope, Heart Failure. Once symptomatic, survival drops fast! (TAVR vs SAVR)
cards.name: Arnie Aortic Stenosis
cards.power: Fixed Outflow – Restrict LV emptying.

cards.art: playful otter surfing reverse flood through collapsing dam, water flooding upstream
cards.lore: Acute MR (papillary rupture) is a shock emergency. Chronic MR is compensated for years.
cards.name: Mitty Mitral Regurgitation
cards.power: Volume Overload – Flood the left atrium and lungs.

cards.art: massive walrus wedged in narrow ice crack, straining forward
cards.lore: Almost always rheumatic in origin. Listen for the opening snap!
cards.name: Mitty Mitral Stenosis
cards.power: Atrial Stretch – Dilation, AFib, and Pulmonary HTN.

cards.art: red-orange pangolin in full armor, sparks flying from pericardial friction
cards.lore: If fluid accumulates fast, Tamponade hits (Beck's Triad, Pulsus Paradoxus). Time for pericardiocentesis!
cards.name: The Pericardial Knight
cards.power: Friction Rub – Positional sharp chest pain.

cards.art: elephant sitting heavily on blue pulmonary artery, small strained heart beside
cards.lore: Group 1 gets advanced pulmonary vasodilators. Groups 2–5 need their root cause fixed!
cards.name: Pulmonary Pressure Problem
cards.power: RV Strain – Cor Pulmonale and right heart failure.

cards.art: exhausted donkey buried under OXIDIZED LDL cardboard boxes, dropping into artery wall
cards.lore: Statins first. If LDL targets aren't met in high-risk patients, deploy PCSK9 inhibitors!
cards.name: Cholesterol Carl
cards.power: Delivery Boy – Drop lipid packages into the vascular intima.

cards.art: worm in safety vest holding ANTITHROMBIN III stop sign at Thrombin and Factor Xa
cards.lore: Reversible with protamine. LMWH (enoxaparin) requires less monitoring but renally cleared!
cards.name: Hep the Heparin
cards.power: Antithrombin III Buff – Inhibit Thrombin and Factor Xa.

cards.art: armored NOAC squad with shields arresting red Factor Xa punk
cards.lore: Replaced warfarin for most AFib/VTE. Reverse dabigatran with idarucizumab, Xa with andexanet alfa.
cards.name: The NOAC Squad
cards.power: Direct Blockade – Predictable kinetics, no INR checks.

cards.art: great horned owl in lab coat holding synthesis checklist clipboard, stern gaze
cards.lore: 68yo diabetic, AFib, EF 32%. Build the optimal regimen, spot the interactions, set the targets!
cards.name: The Cardiology Attending
cards.power: Pimping – Demand a fully integrated clinical regimen.

cards.art: cheerful FrizzleBob rabbit holding golden stethoscope, carrot in pocket, DNR THIS DECK! burst
cards.lore: The science is real, the absurdity makes it permanent. You remember stories, not spreadsheets.
cards.name: FrizzleBob's Golden Stethoscope
cards.power: Story trumps Lists – Discard rote memorization.
